title: Telling the time on a clock step by step
examples: How do I tell the time?

explain.say: Imagine a clock is a face with two hands, a short one and a long one. Look at the clock on the board. The long hand points straight up to 12, and the short hand points to 3. It is three o'clock!

draw.text: Telling the time on a clock step by step

explain.say: Now let me show you the real thing in 3D: an analogue clock. Look at the hour hand, the minute hand and the second hand. Tap any part, and I will tell you what it does.

draw.text: Telling the time on a clock step by step

explain.say: Step one: the short hand tells the hour. Step two: the long hand tells the minutes. When the long hand points straight up to 12, it is o'clock. Here the short hand points to 7. What time is it?
Now the long hand has gone halfway round, pointing down to 6. That is half past! The short hand is halfway between 7 and 8. So it is half past seven. Can you point down like the long hand?
When the long hand points to 3, it has gone a quarter of the way round. That is quarter past. Quarter past seven! Think of a pizza with one slice gone. Can you see the quarter?

When the long hand points to 9, it is quarter to the next hour. Here it is quarter to eight. Wow, you can read o'clock, half past, quarter past and quarter to! Challenge: look at a clock at home at bedtime.

faq.a: The short hand tells the hour. It moves only from one number to the next in a whole hour.
asks: Tell me about the short hand

faq.a: The long hand tells the minutes. It goes all the way round the clock once every hour.
asks: Tell me about the long hand

faq.a: Half past means thirty minutes after the hour. The long hand points down to 6. A teacher or grown-up can help you practise with a toy clock.
Quarter past means fifteen minutes after the hour. The long hand points to 3.
Quarter to means fifteen minutes before the next hour. The long hand points to 9.

facts: The minute hand goes all the way round a clock once every hour.
At half past, the minute hand points to 6 and the hour hand is halfway between two numbers.

quiz.say: The long hand points to 12 and the short hand points to 5. What time is it?
quiz.show: Long hand on 12, short hand on 5. What time?
quiz.why: The short hand shows the hour, 5, and the long hand on 12 means o'clock.

wrong.1: The long hand is on 12, but it shows minutes. The short hand shows the hour: 5.
wrong.2: At half past, the long hand points down to 6, not up to 12.

quiz.say: Where does the long hand point at half past?
quiz.show: At half past, the long hand points to…
quiz.why: Half past means halfway round, so the long hand points down to 6.
